Warren Avenue is a QLINE streetcar station in Midtown Detroit, Michigan. The station opened for service on May 12, 2017.  The station is located in the Cultural Center Historic District, and services Wayne State University's campus and the Detroit Medical Center.
Station
Warren Avenue is located near the Detroit Institute of Arts, Michigan Science Center, Charles H. Wright Museum of African-American History, Cathedral Church of St. Paul, and the main location of the Detroit Public Library.
The station is heated and features security cameras, emergency phones, passenger information displays, and Wi-Fi. Wayne State University is its presenting sponsor.
